messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "if you switched to fluticasone from another steroid medicine you should not stop using it suddenly"
set: ["if you switched to fluticasone from another steroid medicine you should not stop using it suddenly", "you should not stop using carvedilol suddenly", "if you have switched from another anxiety medication", "do not stop using an oral steroid medication suddenly", "do not stop using suddenly", "do not stop using venlafaxine suddenly", "do not stop using escitalopram suddenly", "do not stop suddenly", "doctor should review from time to time whether you still need it", "do not stop taking suddenly", "you may need to stop using the medicine for a short time", "should not breastfeed while using this medicine", "keep using this medicine even if you feel well", "do not stop unless doctor tells you to", "you do not need to shake before using", "do not change dose or stop suddenly unless you have a seizure"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
